sentences.en: Our story begins in the early 90s with an orca named Keiko.
sentences.zh: 我们的故事始于90年代初，主角是一头名叫凯科的虎鲸。

sentences.en: He's just entering his teenage years, living at an amusement park in Mexico City called
sentences.zh: 他当时刚进入青少年时期，住在墨西哥城的一家游乐园里，名叫

sentences.en: Reino Aventura, or Adventure Kingdom.
sentences.zh: Reino Aventura，即“冒险王国”。

sentences.en: He's not from there, but for the last seven years, a tank in this polluted, landlocked megacity more than 7,000 feet above sea level has been his home.
sentences.zh: 他并非来自那里，但在过去七年里，这个位于海拔7000多英尺、污染严重的内陆大都市里的水箱一直是他的家。

sentences.en: Before that, it was a marine park in Canada, where he was bullied by the other orcas.
sentences.zh: 在那之前，他住在加拿大的一家海洋公园，在那里他被其他虎鲸欺负。

sentences.en: Before that, it was a tank in a big concrete building in Iceland, where he was kept for about three years, unable to see the sky.
sentences.zh: 再之前，他住在冰岛一栋大型混凝土建筑里的水箱中，被关了大约三年，无法看到天空。

sentences.en: And even before that, it was the North Atlantic, where he was captured and separated from his mom and the rest of his whale pod, probably when he was around too.
sentences.zh: 甚至在那之前，他生活在北大西洋，在那里他被捕获并与母亲及鲸群的其他成员分离，当时他大概两岁左右。

sentences.en: I don't think I really understood how traumatic this could have been until I learned that male killer whales are essentially mama's boys.
sentences.zh: 直到我了解到雄性虎鲸本质上是“妈宝”时，我才真正理解这对他来说是多么痛苦的经历。

sentences.en: And not just when they're young, but basically their entire lives.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是在幼年时期，基本上是他们的一生。

sentences.en: Even as adults, they might swim by their mother's side.
sentences.zh: 即使成年后，他们也可能游在母亲身边。

sentences.en: They depend on her.
sentences.zh: 他们依赖她。

sentences.en: A mother orca might catch a fish, bite it in two, and give half to her son.
sentences.zh: 虎鲸妈妈可能会抓一条鱼，咬成两半，分给儿子一半。

sentences.en: This kind of closeness is documented in male orcas well into their 20s or 30s.
sentences.zh: 这种亲密关系在雄性虎鲸20多岁甚至30多岁时都有记录。

sentences.en: And Keiko was deprived of the chance to have that.
sentences.zh: 而凯科被剥夺了拥有这种机会的权利。

sentences.en: At age two, Keiko would probably still have been swimming in his mother's slipstream, still mastering the language of his pod.
sentences.zh: 两岁时，凯科本应该还在母亲的尾流中游动，还在学习鲸群的语言。

sentences.en: He wouldn't have yet learned how to hunt on his own.
sentences.zh: 他那时还没学会如何独自捕猎。

sentences.en: Despite weighing more than a thousand pounds, in developmental terms, Keiko would have been just a baby.
sentences.zh: 尽管体重超过一千磅，但在发育阶段，凯科当时还只是个婴儿。

sentences.en: Ripped from his mother, from everything he'd ever known, and from a life that may have been largely spent by her side.
sentences.zh: 他被从母亲身边、从他所知的一切、以及可能大部分时间都在她身边度过的生活中强行带走。

sentences.en: So of course it's hard to talk about a pool in a Mexican amusement park as a substitute for any of that.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然很难说墨西哥游乐园里的一个水池能替代这一切。

sentences.en: But what I can say is that the people who work there, they truly, sincerely love Keiko.
sentences.zh: 但我能说的是，在那里工作的人们，他们真心实意地爱着凯科。

sentences.en: They are, for all intents and purposes, his pod.
sentences.zh: 无论从什么角度来看，他们就是他的鲸群。

sentences.en: Well, obviously, my purpose in life at that time, it was Keiko, and Keiko only.
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然，我当时的人生目标就是凯科，只有凯科。

sentences.en: That's Renata Fernandez, who worked with Keiko at Reino Aventura.
sentences.zh: 那是雷娜塔·费尔南德斯，她曾在Reino Aventura与凯科一起工作。

sentences.en: Before having kids, he was my kid.
sentences.zh: 在有孩子之前，他就是我的孩子。

sentences.en: He was my baby.
sentences.zh: 他是我的宝贝。

sentences.en: He was, I mean, I had boyfriends back then, but they were not that important as Keiko.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那时我有男朋友，但他们没有凯科那么重要。

sentences.en: I had to break up with two boyfriends because I spent most of my time with him.
sentences.zh: 我不得不和两个男朋友分手，因为我大部分时间都和他在一起。

sentences.en: I mean, it was, I worked there for seven years, and it was the best seven years of my life.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我在那里工作了七年，那是我一生中最美好的七年。

sentences.en: Renata started at Reino Aventura when she was 20 years old.
sentences.zh: 雷娜塔20岁时开始在Reino Aventura工作。

sentences.en: She chopped frozen fish, mopped the pool deck, and eventually worked her way up to be one of Keiko's trainers.
sentences.zh: 她切冻鱼、拖池边甲板，最终晋升为凯科的训练员之一。

sentences.en: Working with a killer whale had long been a dream of hers.
sentences.zh: 与虎鲸一起工作一直是她的梦想。

sentences.en: And even now, when she talks about Keiko, she sounds the way a mother might when reminiscing about her kid's childhood.
sentences.zh: 即使是现在，当她谈起凯科时，她的语气就像一位母亲在回忆孩子童年时的样子。

sentences.en: She remembers all of Keiko's favorite games, his favorite toys, his favorite playmate.
sentences.zh: 她记得凯科所有喜欢的游戏、他最爱的玩具、他最好的玩伴。

sentences.en: His best friend was a dolphin named Richie, and they would just play nonstop.
sentences.zh: 他最好的朋友是一只叫里奇的海豚，他们总是玩个不停。

sentences.en: And between shows, he would just have Richie on top of him, just kind of like giving him a ride.
sentences.zh: 在表演间隙，他会让里奇骑在他背上，就像载着它一样。

sentences.en: If Keiko had his moods or played favorites, well, Renata says, that was just part of who he was.
sentences.zh: 如果凯科有情绪或偏爱谁，嗯，雷娜塔说，那只是他性格的一部分。

sentences.en: Keiko would choose who to play with.
sentences.zh: 凯科会选择和谁玩。

sentences.en: I mean, we had this very young girl, she was 16 or 17, and she would come into the water, and it was like a magnet for Keiko.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们有个很年轻的女孩，才16或17岁，她一下水，就像对凯科有磁力一样。

sentences.en: He would love her, love to be with her.
sentences.zh: 他会爱她，喜欢和她在一起。

sentences.en: And why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Nobody knows.
sentences.zh: 没人知道。

sentences.en: I mean, it's just, you know, it's like chemistry.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这就像化学反应一样。

sentences.en: In the off-season, when there were no weekday shows at Reino Aventura, Renata and the other trainers swam and played with Keiko for hours.
sentences.zh: 在淡季，当Reino Aventura没有平日表演时，雷娜塔和其他训练员会和凯科一起游泳玩耍好几个小时。

sentences.en: Most of the people who worked with Keiko were young, none older than 30, and they made Keiko the center of their lives.
sentences.zh: 大多数与凯科一起工作的人都很年轻，没有超过30岁的，他们把凯科当作生活的中心。

sentences.en: They fed him by hand, gave him belly rubs all the time.
sentences.zh: 他们亲手喂他，总是给他揉肚子。

sentences.en: They even set up a special hose just for him.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至专门为他安装了一根软管。

sentences.en: He loved to be sprayed.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢被喷水。

sentences.en: And as far as anyone could tell, Keiko genuinely seemed to like it.
sentences.zh: 据大家所知，凯科似乎真的很喜欢这样。

sentences.en: We had this little boat, and there was a rope tied to the front, like a long rope.
sentences.zh: 我们有一艘小船，前面系着一根绳子，很长的一根绳子。

sentences.en: But we would put it in the water, and like three girls would get, you know, hop in it, and he would pull us
sentences.zh: 我们会把它放进水里，然后三个女孩跳上去，他就会拉着我们

sentences.en: all over the pool, and then he would pull it down just to make us fall from the boat.
sentences.zh: 在池子里到处转，然后他会把船拉沉，好让我们从船上掉下来。

sentences.en: And that was over and over.
sentences.zh: 就这样一遍又一遍。

sentences.en: And obviously, we would laugh and then get on top of the little boat.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们会大笑，然后爬回小船上。

sentences.en: Again, he would, you know, give us a ride again.
sentences.zh: 他又会载我们一程。

sentences.en: So, I mean, he would have a blaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是说，他玩得很开心。

sentences.en: There's nothing about that last sentence of Renata's that can be fact-checked.
sentences.zh: 雷娜塔最后那句话没有任何事实依据可以核实。

sentences.en: Not a word.
sentences.zh: 一个字都没有。

sentences.en: We don't know if Keiko was having a blaSt. We can't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道凯科是否真的“玩得很开心”。我们无法得知。

sentences.en: Maybe he was dragging the trainers around because he was bored, or because he loved these friendly people who fed him every day.
sentences.zh: 也许他拖着训练员到处跑是因为他无聊，或者因为他喜欢这些每天喂他的友好人类。

sentences.en: Maybe what his humans interpreted as Keiko having fun was really just habit, or even defeat, like, why not let the people ride?
sentences.zh: 也许人类解读为凯科在玩乐的行为，其实只是习惯，甚至是屈服，比如，为什么不让这些人骑呢？

sentences.en: They seem to like it.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来很喜欢。

sentences.en: We can't really know what animals are thinking, so we do our best with the information we have, making educated guesses about the inner lives of the creatures we love.
sentences.zh: 我们无法真正了解动物在想什么，所以我们只能利用现有的信息尽力而为，对我们所爱生物的内心世界做出有根据的猜测。

sentences.en: And that's what the story is really about.
sentences.zh: 而这正是这个故事的真正主题。

sentences.en: An imperfect attempt to understand what might be best for an animal who can't speak for himself.
sentences.zh: 一次不完美的尝试，去理解对于一个无法为自己发声的动物来说，什么才是最好的。

sentences.en: The intention to make things right for him, to make things better.
sentences.zh: 为了他把事情做对，为了让情况变得更好。

sentences.en: Everything I'm going to tell you in the next six episodes was set in motion by these good intentions.
sentences.zh: 我在接下来的六集里要告诉你们的一切，都是由这些善意所推动的。

sentences.en: And by everything, I mean an unprecedented global campaign, a high-profile, high-stakes science experiment, and a debate about what exactly we, humans, owe the natural world.
sentences.zh: 所谓“一切”，是指一场史无前例的全球运动、一场备受瞩目且风险极高的科学实验，以及一场关于我们人类究竟欠自然界什么的辩论。

sentences.en: At the center of it all is Keiko, who would become, almost by accident, a symbol for all whales, for the health of the oceans, for the very concept of wildness,
sentences.zh: 这一切的核心是凯科，他几乎是偶然地成为了所有鲸鱼、海洋健康以及“野性”这一概念的象征，

sentences.en: but who was also an individual orca with a name and specific history and trauma and character.
sentences.zh: 但他同时也是一个个体虎鲸，有着名字、特定的历史、创伤和性格。

sentences.en: A character with fears and limitations that no human could ever hope to interpret with any certainty.
sentences.zh: 一个有着任何人类都无法确定解读的恐惧和局限性的角色。

sentences.en: Not that they wouldn't try.
sentences.zh: 并不是说他们不会尝试。

sentences.en: In fact, lots of well-intentioned people would claim they knew exactly what was best for this whale.
sentences.zh: 事实上，许多善意的人会声称他们确切地知道这对这头鲸鱼来说什么是最好的。

sentences.en: And they would be arguing and fighting over those interpretations for years.
sentences.zh: 他们会为了这些解读争论和斗争多年。

sentences.zh: 来自Serial Productions和《纽约时报》，这是《好鲸鱼》。

sentences.en: It wasn't just Renata and the other trainers who loved Keiko, or even just the people in Mexico City who went to see Keiko at Reno Aventura.
sentences.zh: 他深受喜爱，是一种国民吉祥物。

sentences.en: It seems like pretty much every kid in Mexico knew him.
sentences.zh: 他就像宠物，墨西哥的宠物。

sentences.en: He was beloved, a kind of national mascot.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的一个人把他比作墨西哥的米老鼠。

sentences.en: He was like the pet, Mexico's pet.
sentences.zh: 事实上，很多人以为凯科是墨西哥人，就是那种土生土长的墨西哥人。

sentences.en: One person I spoke to compared him to a Mexican Mickey Mouse.
sentences.zh: 他们从未想过他可能来自其他任何地方。

sentences.en: And in fact, a lot of people assumed that Keiko was Mexican, like actually from Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他就是属于他们的。

sentences.en: They never considered that he could have come from anywhere else.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了许多在80年代和90年代在墨西哥城长大的人。

sentences.en: He was just theirs.
sentences.zh: 他们反复说凯科身上有一种光环。

sentences.en: We talked to lots of people who grew up in Mexico City in the 80s and
sentences.zh: 在Reino Aventura看他就像和自己7000磅重的好朋友待在一起，那是你向其倾诉秘密的虎鲸，
告诉他学校里发生了什么，你暗恋谁。

sentences.en: And they said again and again that Keiko had an aura about him.
sentences.zh: 就是那种关系。

sentences.en: That seeing him at Reno Aventura was like hanging out with your 7,000-pound best friend, the killer whale you told your secrets to,
sentences.zh: 如果你在80年代末或90年代初看墨西哥的电视，很有可能迟早会看到凯科。

sentences.en: what was happening at school, who your crush was.
sentences.zh: 当然，他出现在Reino Aventura的广告里。

sentences.en: It was that kind of relationship.
sentences.zh: 还有专门为他创作的流行歌曲。

sentences.en: If you watched television in Mexico in the late 80s or early 90s, chances were that sooner or later, you'd see Keiko.
sentences.zh: 他甚至以自己的身份主演了一部电视连续剧。

sentences.en: He was in Reno Aventura commercials, of course.
sentences.zh: 还有那些表演，游客们可以近距离观看他们心爱的宠物。

sentences.en: There were pop songs dedicated to him.
sentences.zh: Reino Aventura已经不存在了，至少不再叫那个名字了。

sentences.en: He even starred in a telenovela, as himself.
sentences.zh: 它后来被六旗乐园收购了。

sentences.en: And then there were the shows, when visitors got to see their beloved pet up close.
sentences.zh: 但在90年代初的全盛时期，凯科是明星景点。

sentences.en: Reno Aventura doesn't exist anymore, not under that name anyway.
sentences.zh: 这些表演简直是传奇。

sentences.en: It's since been acquired by Six Flags.
sentences.zh: 在他名气最盛的时候，大门开放前几个小时可能就有200人排队。

sentences.en: But back in its heyday, in the early 90s, Keiko was the star attraction.
sentences.zh: 一对小丑吹着小号走来走去，娱乐着排队入场的凯科粉丝。

sentences.en: And these shows, they were legendary.

sentences.en: I guess.

sentences.zh: 坏鲸鱼是威利，它被捕获并与族群分离，困在破旧水族馆的一个小水池里。

sentences.en: The park staff find him stubborn, hard to train.
sentences.zh: 公园员工觉得它很固执，难以训练。

sentences.en: He has three black spots on the underside of his jaw.
sentences.zh: 它的下颚下方有三个黑点。

sentences.en: His dorsal fin droops to one side, a killer whale's version of an emo haircut.
sentences.zh: 它的背鳍向一侧下垂，就像虎鲸版的非主流发型。

sentences.en: Jesse decides he has to save Willie's life, get him back to the ocean, back to his family.
sentences.zh: Jesse决定他必须拯救威利的生命，把它送回大海，回到它的家人身边。

sentences.en: And somehow, against all kinds of obstacles, he does.
sentences.zh: 不知何故，克服了重重阻碍，他做到了。

sentences.en: I know you can jump this wall!
sentences.zh: 我知道你能跳过这堵墙！

sentences.en: Come on, I believe in you, Willie.
sentences.zh: 来吧，我相信你，威利。

sentences.en: You can do it!
sentences.zh: 你能做到的！

sentences.zh: 你可以重获自由！

sentences.zh: 电影海报是大多数人记忆最深的部分。

sentences.en: It's the image that was absorbed into the culture, a still from the film's climax.
sentences.zh: 那是融入了流行文化的画面，电影高潮时刻的剧照。

sentences.en: Willie, in mid-flight, against an orange sunset, jumping over a breakwater.
sentences.zh: 威利在橙色的夕阳下腾空而起，跃过防波堤。

sentences.en: The ocean beckons.
sentences.zh: 大海在召唤。

sentences.en: The boy stands just below Willie, beneath an arc of sea spray, a triumphant arm pointing to the sky.
sentences.zh: 男孩站在威利下方，在飞溅的海浪弧线中，一只胜利的手臂指向天空。

sentences.en: The tagline reads, How far would you go for a friend?
sentences.zh: 宣传语写着：为了朋友，你能走多远？

sentences.zh: 至于谁来扮演威利，华纳兄弟并没有

sentences.zh: 华纳兄弟并没有太多的虎鲸可以选择。

sentences.en: A producer on the film told us her team approached a few different marine parks, but people weren't excited about the message of the movie and wanted changes to the script.
sentences.zh: 电影的一位制片人告诉我们，她的团队接触了几家不同的海洋公园，但人们对电影传达的信息并不感兴趣，并希望修改剧本。

sentences.en: Finally, they landed on Reno Aventura, who signed off, as we mentioned, without even reading it.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们选择了Reno Aventura，正如我们提到的，对方甚至没看剧本就签了字。

sentences.en: And Keiko, it turns out, was perfect for the part.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，Keiko是这个角色的完美人选。

sentences.en: See, for the film to work, the producers needed something very specific, a kind of sad-looking whale living in less-than-ideal conditions.
sentences.zh: 你看，为了让电影成功，制片人需要非常具体的东西：一条看起来很忧伤、生活在不理想环境中的鲸鱼。

sentences.en: They needed a whale kids would feel sorry for, a whale children would want to save.
sentences.zh: 他们需要一条孩子们会感到同情、想要拯救的鲸鱼。

sentences.en: And the fact is, while Keiko might have been happy, he wasn't actually that healthy.
sentences.zh: 事实是，虽然Keiko可能很快乐，但它其实并不健康。

sentences.en: He was a couple thousand pounds underweight.
sentences.zh: 它体重不足了几千磅。

sentences.en: Not because he was underfed, but probably because the warm water affected his appetite.
sentences.zh: 不是因为喂食不足，而是因为温暖的水温影响了它的食欲。

sentences.en: He had a skin rash too, something called papillomavirus, which looked bad, even though the veterinarian at Reno Aventura said it wasn't that serious.
sentences.zh: 它还患有皮肤病，一种叫乳头状瘤病毒的东西，看起来很糟糕，尽管Reno Aventura的兽医说并不严重。

sentences.en: But most striking of all was his tank.
sentences.zh: 但最引人注目的是它的水池。

sentences.en: It was small, disturbingly small.
sentences.zh: 它很小，小得令人不安。

sentences.en: One of the film's producers joked it was smaller than some swimming pools in Beverly Hills.
sentences.zh: 电影的一位制片人开玩笑说，它比比佛利山庄的一些游泳池还要小。

sentences.en: The water he swam in wasn't even seawater, just fresh water with salt added.
sentences.zh: 它游的水甚至不是海水，只是加了盐的淡水。

sentences.en: Renata says they checked the salt levels frequently and they weren't under any illusions that Keiko's living conditions were ideal.
sentences.zh: Renata说他们经常检查盐度，他们很清楚Keiko的生活条件并不理想。

sentences.en: She told me Reno Aventura looked into building a larger pool, but just couldn't make it work financially.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，Reno Aventura曾考虑建造一个更大的水池，但财务上实在无法实现。

sentences.en: So strip away for a moment almost everything I've told you.
sentences.zh: 所以，暂时抛开我告诉你的几乎所有事情。

sentences.en: Forget the love and the games and the trainers and the fans, and see instead what the camera sees.
sentences.zh: 忘掉那些爱、游戏、训练员和粉丝，看看摄像机所看到的。

sentences.en: Keiko, a smaller-than-average killer whale with the droopy dorsal fin, swimming alone in a tiny, shallow pool.
sentences.zh: Keiko，一条背鳍下垂、体型偏小的虎鲸，独自游在一个狭小、浅浅的水池里。

sentences.en: He was exactly what the movie required.
sentences.zh: 它正是电影所需要的。

sentences.en: Free Willy was released on July 16, 1993, and the reviews were positive, at least until journalists started asking what was up with the star of the movie.
sentences.zh: 《人鱼童话》于1993年7月16日上映，评价很正面，直到记者们开始询问电影主角的情况。

sentences.en: And news reports about Keiko's subpar living conditions and health began spreading.
sentences.zh: 关于Keiko糟糕的生活条件和健康状况的新闻报道开始传播。

sentences.en: The movie Free Willy has a great ending, but real life didn't treat the real star of the box office hit the way it treated Willy in the movie.
sentences.zh: 电影《人鱼童话》有一个完美的结局，但现实生活并没有像对待电影里的威利那样对待这位票房冠军的真正主角。

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也没有。

sentences.en: News tonight that will surely upset all those children who saw the movie Free Willy this summer.
sentences.zh: 今晚的新闻肯定会让所有今年夏天看过电影《人鱼童话》的孩子们感到难过。

sentences.en: The whale that starred in the movie is sick and may die unless his living conditions are improved.
sentences.zh: 电影里的那条鲸鱼病了，如果不改善生活条件，它可能会死。

sentences.en: Soon enough, Keiko had gone from Mexico's beloved pet to Mexico's dying orca and kids around the world were not happy.
sentences.zh: 很快，Keiko从墨西哥的宠儿变成了墨西哥垂死的虎鲸，全世界的孩子们都不高兴了。

sentences.en: I'm writing this letter to ask you to consider helping the killer whale Keiko in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我写这封信是想请你们考虑帮助墨西哥的虎鲸Keiko。

sentences.en: We would like everybody to donate a dollar and we'd get lots of money so we can try to help save this whale.
sentences.zh: 我们希望每个人都能捐一美元，这样我们就能筹到很多钱来拯救这条鲸鱼。

sentences.en: Here, this whale that people have made millions off of, and now he's just sitting in this tank dying.
sentences.zh: 你看，这条人们靠它赚了数百万美元的鲸鱼，现在却只能待在这个水池里等死。

sentences.en: I don't think Keiko deserves to die.
sentences.zh: 我不认为Keiko应该死。

sentences.en: In Mexico, Reno Aventura and the staff were suddenly having to defend themselves in ways they hadn't
sentences.zh: 在墨西哥，Reno Aventura和员工们突然不得不以他们从未有过的方式为自己辩护，

sentences.en: before, trying to convince crusading celebrities and animal rights activists that they did indeed care about Keiko's well-being.
sentences.zh: 试图说服那些激进的名人和动物权利活动家，他们确实关心Keiko的福祉。

sentences.en: When Life magazine published an article describing Keiko's tank as a cesspool, Reno Aventura's director Oscar Porter sent a letter claiming the magazine had gotten it all
sentences.zh: 当《生活》杂志发表文章称Keiko的水池是污水坑时，Reno Aventura的负责人Oscar Porter发了一封信，声称杂志完全搞错了，

sentences.en: wrong, that Keiko's water was, quote, clean and clear.
sentences.zh: Keiko的水是“干净清澈的”。

sentences.en: Back in Hollywood, Warner Brothers was getting hammered too.
sentences.zh: 在好莱坞，华纳兄弟也受到了猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: Bags and bags of mail from kids arrived at the offices, all demanding the same thing.
sentences.zh: 孩子们寄来的成堆信件涌入办公室，要求都是同一件事。

sentences.en: Free Willy.
sentences.zh: 释放威利。

sentences.en: Or rather, free Keiko.
sentences.zh: 或者说，释放Keiko。

sentences.en: And so, if the studio wanted to avoid a PR nightmare and not break the hearts of millions of children, then it was clear.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果制片厂想避免公关噩梦，不想伤透数百万孩子的心，那么答案很明确。

sentences.en: Someone had to save him.
sentences.zh: 必须有人救它。

sentences.en: In real life.
sentences.zh: 在现实生活中。

sentences.en: That's after the break.
sentences.zh: 休息之后继续。

sentences.en: For centuries, we humans hunted and killed whales as if their numbers were infinite.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，我们人类捕杀鲸鱼，仿佛它们的数量无穷无尽。

sentences.en: And over time, we got better and better at it.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我们越来越擅长此道。

sentences.en: More efficient, more ruthless, extracting more value from each kill.
sentences.zh: 效率更高，手段更残忍，从每一次捕杀中榨取更多价值。

sentences.en: We harvested their blubber, their organs, their baleen, their meat.
sentences.zh: 我们收割它们的鲸脂、内脏、鲸须和肉。

sentences.en: And it was all transformed into everyday commercial products, from makeup to heating oil.
sentences.zh: 这一切都被转化为日常商业产品，从化妆品到取暖油。

sentences.en: More than 700,000 whales were killed in the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 20世纪60年代，超过70万头鲸鱼被杀。

sentences.en: Whaling was a huge global industry, with profits to match.
sentences.zh: 捕鲸是一个巨大的全球产业，利润丰厚。

sentences.en: The killing of orcas was a little different, since they didn't have much to offer us, commercially speaking.
sentences.zh: 捕杀虎鲸的情况略有不同，因为从商业角度来看，它们对我们没什么用处。

sentences.en: But humans being humans, we killed them anyway.
sentences.zh: 但人类毕竟是人类，我们还是杀了它们。

sentences.en: For fear, for sport, for blood luSt. Fishermen trawling for herring or salmon saw them as competitors, so they would shoot them on sight.
sentences.zh: 出于恐惧、运动、嗜血。捕捞鲱鱼或鲑鱼的渔民视它们为竞争对手，所以他们一见到就会开枪射杀。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国海军

sentences.en: Navy would use orcopods for target practice.
sentences.zh: 会把虎鲸群当作打靶练习的目标。

sentences.en: All told, it's estimated that some 3 million individual whales were killed by humans in the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，据估计20世纪人类杀死了约300万头鲸鱼。

sentences.en: By the early 1970s, scientists understood that whales were far more scarce than we'd all previously thought, and began warning that the
sentences.zh: 到20世纪70年代初，科学家们意识到鲸鱼的数量远比我们之前想象的要稀少，并开始警告说，

sentences.en: steep declines they were seeing in wild populations might be irreversible.
sentences.zh: 他们观察到的野生种群急剧下降可能是不可逆转的。

sentences.en: In response, the Save the
sentences.zh: 作为回应，“拯救鲸鱼”运动诞生了，

sentences.en: Whales movement was born, with the goal of ending commercial whaling worldwide.
sentences.zh: 目标是在全球范围内结束商业捕鲸。

sentences.en: A bold, quixotic idea to convince the countries that still practiced whaling to simply stop.
sentences.zh: 一个大胆而堂吉诃德式的想法，去说服那些仍然从事捕鲸的国家直接停止。

sentences.en: I'm telling you all this because in a way, everything that happens to Keiko a couple of decades later is a result of it.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你们这些，是因为在某种程度上，几十年后发生在Keiko身上的一切都是这一运动的结果。

sentences.en: Of this idea that these creatures were worth protecting.
sentences.zh: 源于这些生物值得保护的理念。

sentences.en: And it's also when this next significant person in Keiko's life enters the story.
sentences.zh: 这也是Keiko生命中下一位重要人物登场的时候。

sentences.en: A guy by the name of Dave Phillips.
sentences.zh: 一个叫Dave Phillips的人。

sentences.en: I was pretty young then.
sentences.zh: 那时我还很年轻。

sentences.en: I was like two years out of college.
sentences.zh: 大学毕业才两年左右。

sentences.en: It was the late 70s.
sentences.zh: 那是70年代末。

sentences.en: The Save the Whales campaign was just starting to pick up steam, and Dave wanted in.
sentences.zh: “拯救鲸鱼”运动刚开始升温，Dave想加入其中。

sentences.en: So he packed up his life, drove his turquoise
sentences.zh: 于是他收拾好行囊，开着他的绿松石色

sentences.en: Volkswagen Rabbit out to California, and soon joined the movement to do his part.
sentences.zh: 大众甲壳虫汽车去了加州，很快就加入了这项运动，贡献自己的一份力量。

sentences.en: I was green.
sentences.zh: 我当时是个菜鸟。

sentences.en: There were other people there that were a lot more experienced than I was.
sentences.zh: 那里有其他比我经验丰富得多的人。

sentences.en: I was more likely to be out there with hiking boots and long hair and just getting dirty.
sentences.zh: 我更可能穿着登山靴，留着长发，在外面干些脏活。

sentences.en: So yeah, he was kind of a hippie.
sentences.zh: 所以没错，他算是个嬉皮士。

sentences.en: But he was a hippie with a degree in biology, who found he was too impatient to spend his adult life in a lab studying the minutiae of wildlife without doing anything to save it.
sentences.zh: 但他是一个拥有生物学学位的嬉皮士，他发现自己太没耐心了，无法在实验室里度过余生，研究野生动物的细枝末节却什么都不做去拯救它们。

sentences.en: Given the scale of the environmental crisis he saw, science moved too slowly for him.
sentences.zh: 考虑到他所看到的生态危机规模，科学对他来说进展太慢了。

sentences.en: The central message for the Save the Whales campaign was simple.
sentences.zh: “拯救鲸鱼”运动的核心信息很简单。

sentences.en: Whales are not commodities.
sentences.zh: 鲸鱼不是商品。

sentences.en: They're living beings.
sentences.zh: 它们是生命。

sentences.en: This message was everywhere.
sentences.zh: 这个信息无处不在。

sentences.en: There were bumper stickers and t-shirts emblazoned with the words Save the Whales.
sentences.zh: 到处都是印有“拯救鲸鱼”字样的保险杠贴纸和T恤。

sentences.en: The slogan itself becoming so ubiquitous, it was almost cliche, played as a punchline.
sentences.zh: 这个口号本身变得如此普遍，几乎成了陈词滥调，甚至被当作笑话的梗。

sentences.en: There were Save the Whales marches and rallies across the world, and Dave was there for all of it.
sentences.zh: 世界各地都有“拯救鲸鱼”的游行和集会，Dave参加了所有这些活动。

sentences.en: Most importantly, he was there in 1982, a pivotal moment in his career when the International Whaling Commission caved to the pressure and voted to impose a worldwide
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他在1982年，也就是他职业生涯的关键时刻，当时国际捕鲸委员会屈服于压力，投票决定在全球范围内实施

sentences.en: moratorium on commercial whaling.
sentences.zh: 商业捕鲸禁令。

sentences.en: They'd done it.
sentences.zh: 他们做到了。

sentences.en: They'd saved the whales from what many felt was their almost certain extinction.
sentences.zh: 他们从许多人认为几乎必然灭绝的境地中拯救了鲸鱼。

sentences.en: So Dave learned two things.
sentences.zh: 所以Dave学到了两件事。

sentences.en: One, to succeed, your message had to be everywhere.
sentences.zh: 第一，要成功，你的信息必须无处不在。

sentences.en: If your slogan becomes a joke, so be it.
sentences.zh: 如果你的口号变成了一个笑话，那就随它去吧。

sentences.en: At least people are hearing the message.
sentences.zh: 至少人们听到了这个信息。

sentences.en: And two, whales are magic.
sentences.zh: 第二，鲸鱼是有魔力的。

sentences.en: It's that simple.
sentences.zh: 就这么简单。

sentences.en: They're just one of those species that people fall in love with.
sentences.zh: 它们就是那种人们会爱上的物种之一。

sentences.en: A decade later, in the 90s, Dave's still in the environmental movement, still advocating for wild whales and attending meetings.
sentences.zh: 十年后的90年代，Dave仍然活跃在环保运动中，继续为野生鲸鱼奔走并参加各种会议。

sentences.en: And it's at one of these meetings in Glasgow when he gets a call.
sentences.zh: 就在格拉斯哥的一次会议上，他接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: He's out to dinner with a few colleagues when somebody comes up to the table and says, Is Mr. Phillips here?
sentences.zh: 他正和几位同事在吃晚饭，有人走到桌边问：“请问Phillips先生在吗？”

sentences.en: We have a call for you.
sentences.zh: 我们有你的电话。

sentences.en: Mr. Donner is calling.
sentences.zh: 唐纳先生打来的。

sentences.en: And I'm like,
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，

sentences.en: Oh my goodness, it's just Dick Donner calling from Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 天哪，竟然是好莱坞的迪克·唐纳打来的电话。

sentences.en: Like, what is...
sentences.zh: 就像是，这到底……

sentences.en: And there's Dick.
sentences.zh: 然后迪克就在那儿。

sentences.en: And he's like all in a flutter.
sentences.zh: 他显得非常激动。

sentences.en: I haven't introduced you to Dick Donner yet, but I did mention his wife, Lauren Shuler Donner.
sentences.zh: 我还没向你介绍过迪克·唐纳，但我提过他的妻子，劳伦·舒勒·唐纳。

sentences.en: Together, they were a legit Hollywood power couple, producing or directing blockbusters like
sentences.zh: 他们俩在好莱坞是名副其实的权力夫妻，制作或执导过像

sentences.en: The Goonies and Superman.
sentences.zh: 《七宝奇谋》和《超人》这样的热门大片。

sentences.en: Dick has since passed away, but Lauren told me that they both were self-proclaimed animal lunatics.
sentences.zh: 迪克后来去世了，但劳伦告诉我，他们俩都自称是动物狂热分子。

sentences.en: David actually worked with the couple before.
sentences.zh: 戴夫其实以前和这对夫妇合作过。

sentences.en: They asked him to consult on a few lines of pro-dolphin dialogue in the buddy cop movie, Lethal Weapon 2.
sentences.zh: 他们曾请他就警匪片《致命武器2》中几句关于海豚的台词提供咨询。

sentences.en: Hey, hey, what's that you're eating, Dad?
sentences.zh: 嘿，嘿，爸爸，你在吃什么？

sentences.en: All right, my tuna fish sandwich.
sentences.zh: 好了，是我的金枪鱼三明治。

sentences.en: Tuna?
sentences.zh: 金枪鱼？

sentences.en: Daddy, you can't eat tuna.
sentences.zh: 爸爸，你不能吃金枪鱼。

sentences.en: I can't eat what?
sentences.zh: 我不能吃什么？

sentences.en: Dad kill Flipper.
sentences.zh: 爸爸，那是杀害海豚的凶手。

sentences.en: We're boycotting tuna, honey, because they killed the dolphins and get caught in the nets.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的，我们正在抵制金枪鱼，因为它们捕杀海豚，而且海豚会被困在网里。

sentences.en: Only albacore.
sentences.zh: 只能吃长鳍金枪鱼。

sentences.en: It was small, barely a scene, but Dick felt good about it.
sentences.zh: 那只是个小片段，几乎算不上什么戏份，但迪克对此感觉不错。

sentences.en: And now he had something bigger in mind.
sentences.zh: 现在他有了更大的想法。

sentences.en: Free Willy, a movie he and Lauren were putting together.
sentences.zh: 《威鲸闯天关》，一部他和劳伦正在筹备的电影。

sentences.en: And Dick wanted Dave's help.
sentences.zh: 迪克想寻求戴夫的帮助。

sentences.en: And he's like, you know, this movie is going to be big.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，这部电影会很轰动。

sentences.en: He's like, it's going to be a great movie.
sentences.zh: 他说，这会是一部伟大的电影。

sentences.en: And I'm doing this because I want to make a difference for whales.
sentences.zh: 我做这件事是因为我想为鲸鱼做出改变。

sentences.en: And I want to know, are you in?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，你加入吗？

sentences.en: The whaling band Dave had fought for all those years ago protected whales from commercial slaughter.
sentences.zh: 戴夫多年前为之奋斗的捕鲸禁令保护了鲸鱼免受商业屠杀。

sentences.en: But some species were still captured or killed on a smaller scale.
sentences.zh: 但一些物种仍然在小范围内被捕获或杀害。

sentences.en: The way Dave saw it, Dick and Lauren were offering him an opportunity to finish the job he'd started all those years ago.
sentences.zh: 在戴夫看来，迪克和劳伦给了他一个机会，去完成他多年前就开始的工作。

sentences.en: A chance to save the rest of the whales.
sentences.zh: 一个拯救其余鲸鱼的机会。

sentences.en: Dave and the producers started with something simple.
sentences.zh: 戴夫和制片人们从简单的事情做起。

sentences.en: An 800 number that would pop up on the screen at the end of the movie credits.
sentences.zh: 一个在电影片尾字幕结束时会出现在屏幕上的800免费电话号码。

sentences.en: The idea was that people would call, leave their address, and Dave's organization, Earth Island Institute,
sentences.zh: 想法是人们会打电话，留下地址，然后戴夫的组织——地球岛研究所，

sentences.en: would send them a packet of information about the plight of whales across the world.
sentences.zh: 会给他们寄去一份关于全球鲸鱼困境的信息包。

sentences.en: How they could help.
sentences.zh: 告诉他们如何提供帮助。

sentences.en: The kit was like steps you can take.
sentences.zh: 工具包里列出了一些你可以采取的步骤。

sentences.en: Like, go watch whales in the wild instead of going to watch them in captivity.
sentences.zh: 比如，去野外看鲸鱼，而不是去水族馆看被圈养的鲸鱼。

sentences.en: And put pressure on the International Whaling Commission to stop killing whales.
sentences.zh: 并向国际捕鲸委员会施压，要求停止捕杀鲸鱼。

sentences.en: Nothing too elaborate.
sentences.zh: 没什么太复杂的。

sentences.en: You called the number, you got a kit.
sentences.zh: 你拨打号码，就能收到工具包。

sentences.en: But, fast forward a year, and once the movie was released, and word got out that the star of Free Willy was sick and still living in a tiny pool in Mexico,
sentences.zh: 但是，一年过去了，电影上映后，有消息传出《威鲸闯天关》的主角生病了，而且还被关在墨西哥的一个小水池里，

sentences.en: well, calling an 800 number and getting a kit just didn't feel like enough.
sentences.zh: 好吧，拨打一个800电话并收到一个工具包，感觉已经不够了。

sentences.en: Dave remembers Dick phoning him up again and saying,
sentences.zh: 戴夫记得迪克又打电话给他，说：

sentences.en: We're being crucified down here.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里快被骂死了。

sentences.en: You've got to help us.
sentences.zh: 你必须帮帮我们。

sentences.en: Now Dick was proposing something far more ambitious.
sentences.zh: 现在迪克提议做一些更具雄心的事情。

sentences.en: Something that honestly sounded a little nuts.
sentences.zh: 一些听起来确实有点疯狂的事情。

sentences.en: He said, You've got to get involved in saving Keiko.
sentences.zh: 他说，你必须参与拯救凯科。

sentences.en: Rescuing Keiko from his life in captivity and releasing him back into the ocean, like in the movie.
sentences.zh: 把凯科从圈养生活中解救出来，像电影里那样让他回归大海。

sentences.en: Did you immediately say, like, this is something I can do?
sentences.zh: 你当时有没有立刻说，这事儿我能干？

sentences.en: Or were you like, this man is crazy?
sentences.zh: 还是说，你觉得这个人疯了？

sentences.en: I was like, I was, it was just dizzying because I'm starting to think, wait, how does this even work?
sentences.zh: 我当时，我，这简直让人头晕目眩，因为我开始想，等等，这到底该怎么操作？

sentences.en: What fans of the movie wanted was to see their favorite celebrity orca back in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 电影粉丝们想看到他们最喜欢的明星虎鲸回到大海。

sentences.en: But that wasn't so simple.
sentences.zh: 但这并不简单。

sentences.en: First off, nothing quite this ambitious had ever been attempted.
sentences.zh: 首先，从来没有人尝试过如此宏大的计划。

sentences.en: True, other captive marine mammals had been released to the wild, but they hadn't been in captivity nearly as long as Keiko.
sentences.zh: 诚然，其他被圈养的海洋哺乳动物也被放归过野外，但它们被圈养的时间远没有凯科那么长。

sentences.en: So, saving Keiko would require an extraordinary effort.
sentences.zh: 所以，拯救凯科需要付出非凡的努力。

sentences.en: Dick Donner wanted Dave to do it, but this wasn't exactly Dave's specialty.
sentences.zh: 迪克·唐纳想让戴夫去做，但这并不是戴夫的专长。

sentences.en: His whole career had been focused on big, huge problems, protecting the ocean and saving wild whales, plural.
sentences.zh: 他的整个职业生涯都专注于宏大的问题，保护海洋和拯救野生鲸鱼（复数）。

sentences.en: What Dick was proposing in response to the public outcry around the movie was much narrower in scope.
sentences.zh: 迪克针对电影引发的公众呼声所提议的事情，范围要窄得多。

sentences.en: Saving the whale.
sentences.zh: 拯救那头鲸鱼。

sentences.en: Singular.
sentences.zh: 单数。

sentences.en: Dave remembers telling Dick Donner essentially, thanks, but I'm not the right guy for this job.
sentences.zh: 戴夫记得他基本上是这样告诉迪克·唐纳的：谢谢，但我不是做这份工作的合适人选。

sentences.en: But it seems Dick wouldn't take no for an answer.
sentences.zh: 但迪克似乎不接受拒绝。

sentences.en: He was like, nobody else can do this.
sentences.zh: 他说，没人能做这件事。

sentences.en: You have to do this.
sentences.zh: 你必须做这件事。

sentences.en: You've got to do this.
sentences.zh: 你一定要做这件事。

sentences.en: The kids are depending on it.
sentences.zh: 孩子们指望着它。

sentences.en: Everybody's depending on it.
sentences.zh: 每个人都指望着它。

sentences.en: You've got to do this.
sentences.zh: 你必须做这件事。

sentences.en: Will you try?
sentences.zh: 你愿意试试吗？

sentences.en: And you know, there was something about this that resonated.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这件事确实引起了共鸣。

sentences.en: Think of it this way.
sentences.zh: 换个角度想。

sentences.en: If you're Dave, or an environmentalist of his generation, crazy doesn't necessarily mean impossible.
sentences.zh: 如果你是戴夫，或者他那一代的环保主义者，疯狂并不一定意味着不可能。

sentences.en: Just a few years before, in 1990, an estimated 200 million people took part in Earth Day celebrations.
sentences.zh: 就在几年前的1990年，估计有2亿人参加了地球日庆祝活动。

sentences.en: The most ever, by far.
sentences.zh: 这是迄今为止人数最多的一次。

sentences.en: This is the decade of the Earth Summit in Rio, the Kyoto Protocol.
sentences.zh: 这是里约地球峰会和《京都议定书》的十年。

sentences.en: Big, coordinated global actions to combat climate change and environmental damage.
sentences.zh: 为了应对气候变化和环境破坏，全球采取了大规模的协调行动。

sentences.en: In 1985, scientists announced that they'd discovered a hole in the ozone layer.
sentences.zh: 1985年，科学家宣布他们发现了臭氧层空洞。

sentences.en: And by the 90s, an international treaty was in place to ban some of the chemicals thought to have created it.
sentences.zh: 到了90年代，一项国际条约已经出台，禁止了一些被认为造成了空洞的化学物质。

sentences.en: And it seemed to work.
sentences.zh: 而且似乎奏效了。

sentences.en: The ozone layer began to heal itself.
sentences.zh: 臭氧层开始自我修复。

sentences.en: Even I remember, and I was just a kid, those years were my childhood.
sentences.zh: 连我都记得，那时我还是个孩子，那些年是我的童年。

sentences.en: A time I remember as fundamentally optimistic.
sentences.zh: 那段时光我记忆中是充满乐观的。

sentences.en: We learned about separating our trash in school.
sentences.zh: 我们在学校学习垃圾分类。

sentences.en: Reduce, reuse, recycle, and print it on the brain.
sentences.zh: 减量、重复使用、回收，这些理念印在了脑海里。

sentences.en: We learned about the Amazon and the dangers of climate change, which still felt so far away.
sentences.zh: 我们学习亚马逊雨林和气候变化的危险，尽管那时觉得这些还很遥远。

sentences.en: We didn't despair, because we thought we could still work together to save the planet.
sentences.zh: 我们没有绝望，因为我们认为我们仍然可以共同努力拯救地球。

sentences.en: That if people just knew what was happening, we'd do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 只要人们知道发生了什么，我们就会做正确的事。

sentences.en: And that the right thing would be clear to all of us.
sentences.zh: 而且正确的事对我们所有人来说都是显而易见的。

sentences.en: That's the moment we're in.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所处的时刻。

sentences.en: The moment Dave's in.
sentences.zh: 戴夫所处的时刻。

sentences.en: And so, sure, saving Keiko sounds a bit nutty.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，拯救凯科听起来有点疯狂。

sentences.en: But maybe, if you've seen what he's seen, that sort of thing doesn't scare you.
sentences.zh: 但也许，如果你见过他所见过的，那种事情就不会吓倒你。

sentences.en: So Dave said, okay, I'll check it out.
sentences.zh: 所以戴夫说，好吧，我去看看。

sentences.en: I'll fly down to Mexico City and meet Keiko.
sentences.zh: 我会飞到墨西哥城去见凯科。

sentences.en: He was, if not hopeful, intrigued.
sentences.zh: 他即使没抱希望，也产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: Until he got there and realized, this is a terrible idea.
sentences.zh: 直到他到了那里才意识到，这真是个糟糕的主意。

sentences.en: By the time Dave visited, Keiko was a teenager and had been living in Mexico City for about eight and a half years.
sentences.zh: 戴夫去探访时，凯科已经是个青少年了，在墨西哥城生活了大约八年半。

sentences.en: Dave could see right away.
sentences.zh: 戴夫一眼就看出来了。

sentences.en: This captive whale was nowhere near ready to live in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 这头被圈养的鲸鱼根本没有准备好回归海洋生活。

sentences.en: A wild orca can swim over 100 miles a day.
sentences.zh: 野生虎鲸一天可以游100多英里。

sentences.en: Keiko was basically the aquatic equivalent of a couch potato.
sentences.zh: 凯科基本上就是水里的“沙发土豆”。

sentences.en: First time I ever went to Mexico to see Keiko, I was completely freaked out.
sentences.zh: 我第一次去墨西哥看凯科时，完全被吓坏了。

sentences.en: I was just, I was sitting up in the bleachers, looking down at this whale in this tiny pool in Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 我当时坐在看台上，俯视着墨西哥城这个小水池里的鲸鱼。

sentences.en: And he didn't look good.
sentences.zh: 他看起来状态很差。

sentences.en: He swam in very small circles, and he could make it across his pool in just a matter of seconds.
sentences.zh: 他游得很小的圈，几秒钟就能游过整个水池。

sentences.en: It was a very, very poor facility.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常、非常糟糕的设施。

sentences.en: I almost started crying, really, to tell you the truth.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我差点哭了出来。

sentences.en: I was just hit by it, saying, this is just, this just can't work.
sentences.zh: 我深受打击，心想，这根本行不通。

sentences.en: I asked Dave to tick through the reasons Keiko was not an ideal candidate to rewild.
sentences.zh: 我请戴夫列举了凯科不是野化理想候选者的原因。

sentences.en: And there were many.
sentences.zh: 原因有很多。

sentences.en: Before they could even think of releasing him back into the ocean, Keiko needed to get rid of his papillomavirus, but also get stronger, healthier, put on weight.
sentences.zh: 在考虑让他回归海洋之前，凯科不仅需要摆脱乳头状瘤病毒，还需要变得更强壮、更健康、增加体重。

sentences.en: And there was no way he could do that in his current tank at Reno Aventura.
sentences.zh: 而且他在雷诺·阿文图拉（Reino Aventura）目前的池子里根本做不到这一点。

sentences.en: And where are we supposed to bring him?
sentences.zh: 我们该把他带到哪里去呢？

sentences.en: We're not bringing him into, like, we couldn't bring him into the captive facility.
sentences.zh: 我们不能把他带到……我们不能把他带到圈养设施里。

sentences.en: I'm thinking, where are we going to go?
sentences.zh: 我在想，我们要去哪里？

sentences.en: No, we're not going to take him to some place where he's having to perform or be in a captive environment by where they're making money off of these whales.
sentences.zh: 不，我们不能把他带到那些让他表演，或者让他待在那些靠鲸鱼赚钱的圈养环境里。

sentences.en: We couldn't do that.
sentences.zh: 我们不能那样做。

sentences.en: So we're going to have to build a place.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须建一个地方。

sentences.en: And that's just at step one.
sentences.zh: 而这仅仅是第一步。

sentences.en: The bill for that alone would probably be millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 光是那项开支可能就要数百万美元。

sentences.en: And then they'd have to spend years and millions more teaching him the most basic ocean survival skills and pray that some of those lessons took.
sentences.zh: 然后他们还得花上几年时间和数百万美元来教他最基本的海洋生存技能，并祈祷他能学会其中的一些。

sentences.en: Keiko had lived in the care of humans and without his family since he was around two, missing out on years of life in a pod, years of company and hunting and language and what
sentences.zh: 凯科从两岁左右起就一直由人类照顾，没有家人的陪伴，错过了在鲸群中生活的岁月，错过了多年的同伴、狩猎和语言，以及我

sentences.en: I can only think of as camaraderie, the kind of social environment that makes a killer whale a killer whale.
sentences.zh: 只能称之为友谊的东西，那种让虎鲸成为虎鲸的社会环境。

sentences.en: He had millions of human fans, but not a single orca friend.
sentences.zh: 他有数百万人类粉丝，却连一个虎鲸朋友都没有。

sentences.en: There were so many things he'd never learned.
sentences.zh: 他有太多东西从未学过。

sentences.en: Not only did Keiko not know how to hunt for food, he didn't know how to eat live fish.
sentences.zh: 凯科不仅不知道如何捕食，他甚至不知道怎么吃活鱼。

sentences.en: Think about that.
sentences.zh: 想想看。

sentences.en: If you put a live fish in his mouth, this killer whale wouldn't eat it.
sentences.zh: 如果你把一条活鱼放进他嘴里，这头虎鲸根本不会吃。

sentences.en: And language.
sentences.zh: 还有语言。

sentences.en: Keiko had stopped making most of the sounds in a wild whale's repertoire years before.
sentences.zh: 凯科早在几年前就停止发出野生鲸鱼曲库中的大部分声音了。

sentences.en: Pods have different dialects, and it was unlikely Keiko even remembered the dialect he spoke before his capture.
sentences.zh: 鲸群有不同的方言，凯科很可能连被捕前所说的方言都不记得了。

sentences.en: This was crucially important to his survival.
sentences.zh: 这对他的生存至关重要。

sentences.en: Orcas very rarely live alone in the open ocean, so if he was to make it out there,
sentences.zh: 虎鲸很少独自生活在开阔的海洋中，所以如果他想在那里生存下去，

sentences.en: Dave knew Keiko would have to be integrated into a pod.
sentences.zh: 戴夫知道凯科必须融入一个鲸群。

sentences.en: His original pod, preferably.
sentences.zh: 最好是他原来的那个鲸群。

sentences.en: But if he didn't speak their language, that was going to be difficult.
sentences.zh: 但如果他不会说他们的语言，那将非常困难。

sentences.en: And then there was the small detail that no one knew for certain which pod that might be or where to find them.
sentences.zh: 还有一个细节，没人能确定那个鲸群到底是哪一个，或者去哪里找到它们。

sentences.en: Somewhere in the North Atlantic, near Iceland, presumably.
sentences.zh: 大概是在北大西洋，冰岛附近吧。

sentences.en: How are we going to get him back to Iceland?
sentences.zh: 我们要怎么把他送回冰岛？

sentences.en: It's a whaling nation.
sentences.zh: 那可是个捕鲸国家。

sentences.en: Are you kidding me?
sentences.zh: 你在开玩笑吗？

sentences.en: What, we're going to go over to Iceland and convince them that we want to bring back this whale because the world wants to save him?
sentences.zh: 什么，我们要去冰岛说服他们，说我们要带回这头鲸鱼，因为全世界都想拯救他？

sentences.en: Did you do like a back-of-the-envelope, sort of like, what's-this-going-to-cost thing, like on the plane back?
sentences.zh: 你在回程的飞机上有没有粗略地算过，比如，这会花多少钱？

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Before even on the, while I was down there and on the way back, I was like, I lined it out.
sentences.zh: 甚至在……当我在那里的时候，以及在回来的路上，我就已经列出了清单。

sentences.en: I was way over $10 million.
sentences.zh: 我当时已经超过了1000万美元的预算。

sentences.en: And I was like, at that point, I pretty much just stashed it back in my pack saying, I don't know about this.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，差不多就这样吧，我把它塞回包里，心想，我不知道这事儿能不能成。

sentences.en: It's just, I don't, you know, we're not used to things with six figures behind it.
sentences.zh: 就是，我不知道，你知道的，我们不习惯处理那种六位数金额的事情。

sentences.en: I can see about, like, 10 impossible steps here.
sentences.zh: 我能看出这里大概有10个不可能完成的步骤。

sentences.en: So, 10 impossible steps, at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，至少有10个不可能完成的步骤。

sentences.en: But let's be real.
sentences.zh: 但我们要面对现实。

sentences.en: For Dave, it was also one giant opportunity.
sentences.zh: 对戴夫来说，这也是一个巨大的机遇。

sentences.en: Up until this point, Dave had been thinking about Keiko the way everyone in the world was thinking about Keiko, as one individual killer whale in need of saving.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，戴夫对凯科的看法和世界上所有人一样，认为它只是一头需要拯救的虎鲸个体。

sentences.en: But what if he allowed himself to see it differently?
sentences.zh: 但如果他换个角度看呢？

sentences.en: He'd experienced firsthand the hold that whales had over people at anti-whaling marches across the world.
sentences.zh: 他亲眼见证了在世界各地的反捕鲸游行中，鲸鱼对人们有着怎样的号召力。

sentences.en: He'd seen the power that media campaigns could wield with the Save the Whales movement.
sentences.zh: 他见识过“拯救鲸鱼”运动中媒体宣传所能发挥的力量。

sentences.en: This could be something much bigger.
sentences.zh: 这可能会演变成一件大事。

sentences.en: What if Keiko, the individual, could become Keiko, the symbol?
sentences.zh: 如果凯科这个个体能成为凯科这个象征呢？

sentences.en: What if you could use Keiko to tell a story about the ocean itself?
sentences.zh: 如果你能利用凯科来讲述一个关于海洋本身的故事呢？

sentences.en: You talk about trying to protect all the oceans and that those are the big issues.
sentences.zh: 你谈论保护所有海洋，说那是大问题。

sentences.en: Those are the big, huge, unsolvable problems, global warming, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 那些是宏大、艰巨、无法解决的问题，比如全球变暖等等。

sentences.en: But they're so diffuse.
sentences.zh: 但它们太抽象了。

sentences.en: People can't see acidification rising in the oceans.
sentences.zh: 人们看不见海洋酸化的加剧。

sentences.en: They can't see the coral reefs dying out most of the time.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，他们也看不见珊瑚礁的死亡。

sentences.en: They're not seeing it.
sentences.zh: 他们没看到。

sentences.en: There's nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么都看不见。

sentences.en: It's too broad to say the oceans are dying.
sentences.zh: 说“海洋正在死亡”太笼统了。

sentences.en: There are no grab points.
sentences.zh: 没有抓手。

sentences.en: There are no things to manifest what's at risk.
sentences.zh: 没有具体的东西来体现什么是处于危险之中的。

sentences.en: But whales are one of the things that is just so otherworldly, so majestic, just incredibly, amazingly intelligent, social, powerful.
sentences.zh: 但鲸鱼是那种超凡脱俗、雄伟壮观，而且极其聪明、善于社交、充满力量的生物。

sentences.en: And that means something.
sentences.zh: 这意义非凡。

sentences.en: It hits people in a different way than talking about the threats to the ocean ecosysteMs.
sentences.zh: 它给人们带来的触动，与谈论海洋生态系统受到的威胁完全不同。

sentences.en: And that's what got me over my own view that this is only one whale.
sentences.zh: 这就是让我克服了“这只是一头鲸鱼”这种想法的原因。

sentences.en: It's like, yeah, he's one whale, but he's going to be the most famous or he could be the most famous whale in the world.
sentences.zh: 就像是，没错，它是一头鲸鱼，但它将成为，或者说它可能成为世界上最著名的鲸鱼。

sentences.en: And Dave knew you could do a lot with that kind of star power, with that kind of attention.
sentences.zh: 戴夫知道，利用这种明星效应和关注度，可以做很多事情。

sentences.en: So he set aside his doubts and decided that, yes, as absurd as it sounded, he was all in.
sentences.zh: 于是他抛开了疑虑，决定——是的，尽管听起来很荒谬——他要全力以赴。

sentences.en: Once Dave committed to getting Keiko out of Mexico, the next step was logistics.
sentences.zh: 一旦戴夫下定决心要把凯科从墨西哥带走，下一步就是后勤工作。

sentences.en: And what I'm about to say is pretty obvious, but it's worth saying anyway.
sentences.zh: 我接下来要说的话很显而易见，但还是值得一提。

sentences.en: Moving an orca is not easy.
sentences.zh: 搬运一头虎鲸可不容易。

sentences.en: One of the first things Dave did was create a whole new organization, the Free Willy Keiko Foundation.
sentences.zh: 戴夫做的第一件事就是成立了一个全新的组织：自由威利凯科基金会。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国人道协会捐助了一百万美元。

sentences.en: Humane Society chipped in a million dollars.
sentences.zh: 戴夫又从一位亿万富翁手机大亨那里筹集了几百万。

sentences.en: Dave secured a couple million more from a billionaire cell phone magnet.
sentences.zh: 华纳兄弟也同意投入两百万美元，这听起来很多，但考虑到他们靠《人鱼童话》赚了1.5亿，这就不算什么了。

sentences.en: Warner Brothers also agreed to put in two million dollars, which sounds like a lot, until you consider they made 150 million on Free Willy.
sentences.zh: 到这个时候，续集《人鱼童话2》已经在制作中了。

sentences.en: And by this point, the sequel, Free Willy 2, was already in production.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，有了这笔钱，戴夫还是说服了俄勒冈州的一个小型海洋公园，让他们为基金会建造一个全新的、更大的池子，专门给凯科用。

sentences.en: Still, with that money, Dave was able to convince a small marine park in Oregon to let the foundation build them a new, much bigger pool just for Keiko.
sentences.zh: 现在，戴夫只需要那头鲸鱼了。

sentences.en: And so now, all Dave needed was the whale.
sentences.zh: 你可能会觉得这才是最难的部分，毕竟凯科是雷诺冒险乐园的主打明星。

sentences.en: Which you might assume would be the hard part, given that Keiko was the main attraction at
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，雷诺冒险乐园的负责人奥斯卡·波特并不反对放弃它。

sentences.en: Reno Aventura.
sentences.zh: 他要经营整个公园，而管理他最著名的招牌动物已经成了让他头疼不已的负担。

sentences.en: But it turned out that Oscar Porter, the director of Reno Aventura, wasn't opposed to the idea of giving him up.
sentences.zh: 他要应付记者和活动人士，还有墨西哥的电视明星和歌手打电话来要求和凯科私下游泳。

sentences.en: He had a whole park to run, and managing his most famous attraction had become an all-consuming headache.
sentences.zh: 波特告诉我，他每天要花三个小时处理与凯科相关的琐事，这确实很多，但最令人担忧的是一些外部兽医的说法，他们说凯科可能快不行了。

sentences.en: There were journalists and activists to deal with, Mexican television stars and singers calling to arrange private swims with Keiko.
sentences.zh: 波特真的不想让这种事发生在雷诺冒险乐园。

sentences.en: Porter told me he was spending three hours a day dealing with Keiko-related nonsense, which is a lot, sure, but most worrying of all was what some of the outside veterinarians were
sentences.zh: 于是，在接下来的几个月里，戴夫和奥斯卡·波特达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: saying, that Keiko might die soon.
sentences.zh: 雷诺冒险乐园同意将凯科免费捐赠给戴夫的基金会。

sentences.en: Porter really didn't want that to happen at Reno Aventura.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们很自豪地宣布，我们已经就一项正式计划，一项可行的计划，达成了协议。

sentences.en: So over the course of several months, Dave and Oscar Porter made a deal.
sentences.zh: 1995年2月，全世界宣布凯科将离开雷诺冒险乐园，前往它在俄勒冈海岸水族馆的新临时家园，那里有一个巨大的、装满冷海水的新水箱。

sentences.en: Reno Aventura agreed to donate Keiko to Dave's foundation for free.
sentences.zh: 戴夫为凯科的未来描绘了蓝图，并引用了几个月后即将上映的《人鱼童话2》的剧情。

sentences.en: Today, we are proud to announce that we have breached agreement on a formal plan, a workable plan.
sentences.zh: 在那部电影里，威利与伴侣团聚，有了孩子，生活得很幸福。

sentences.en: In February 1995, it was announced to the world that Keiko would be leaving Reno Aventura for his new temporary home at an aquarium on the Oregon coast in an enormous new tank with
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的目标。

sentences.en: cold seawater.
sentences.zh: 我们非常希望能看到凯科能拥有伴侣，并最终能够被放归野外的情况。

sentences.en: Dave laid out a vision for Keiko's future, invoking the plot to Free Willy 2, which would hit theaters a few months later.
sentences.zh: 营救、康复、放归。

sentences.en: And in that film, Willie is reunited with a mate and has a child and lives happily.
sentences.zh: 这就是戴夫的终极计划，尽管最后一部分看起来希望渺茫。

sentences.en: This is our goal.
sentences.zh: 对于凯科的训练员雷娜塔以及许多与凯科密切共事的工作人员来说，让它离开的决定令人心碎，尽管他们知道这是正确的选择。

sentences.en: We would love to see the situation in which Keiko could have a mate and could be able to eventually be released to the wild.
sentences.zh: 放弃它是一种高尚的，甚至像是母亲般的牺牲。

sentences.en: Rescue, rehab, release.
sentences.zh: 雷娜塔就是这么看的，当然，这并不能减轻她的痛苦。

sentences.en: That was Dave's ultimate plan, even if the last part seemed improbable at beSt.
sentences.zh: 离别总是这样，尤其是当你无法预知未来的时候。

sentences.en: For Keiko's trainer, Renata, and many of the staff that worked closely with Keiko, the decision to let him leave was heartbreaking, even if they knew it was the right one.
sentences.zh: 你会感到内疚，就像背叛了一个朋友。

sentences.en: Giving him up was a kind of noble, even maternal sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 在整个墨西哥，很多人都有这种感觉。

sentences.en: That's how Renata saw it, which of course didn't make it hurt any less.
sentences.zh: 他们想让它留下来。

sentences.en: Goodbyes are like that, especially when you can't explain what the future holds.
sentences.zh: 他们希望它能留下来。

sentences.en: You feel guilty, like you're betraying a friend.
sentences.zh: 但放它走是他们愿意做出的牺牲，因为他们爱它，想要给它最好的。

sentences.en: And across Mexico, a lot of people were feeling this way.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么雷娜塔和我交谈过的许多人觉得，听到美国那边讲述的故事——说凯科是在墨西哥从悲惨的生活中被拯救出来的——是如此令人反感。

sentences.en: They wanted him to stay.
sentences.zh: 你是否觉得有一种“啊，墨西哥，你知道那儿的情况”的意味？

sentences.en: They wished he could stay.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But letting him go was a sacrifice they were willing to make because they loved him and they wanted what was best for him.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Which is why it was so offensive to Renata and many others I talked to, to hear how the story was being told in the U.S., that Keiko was being saved from a terrible life in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: Do you feel like there was an element of like, ah, Mexico, you know how things are down there.
sentences.zh: 她说，是的，我们总是得，你知道，帮助那个小弟弟，因为他什么都做不好。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 我不是说，我不想说这里是动物最好的地方，显然不是。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 但我想说的是，当它在那里时，它得到了很多关注。

sentences.en: Oh, of course.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它得到了所有的关注。

sentences.en: She's like, yeah, we have to always, you know, help the little brother because he does everything wrong.
sentences.zh: 我们总是和它一起玩，你知道，它很喜欢那样。

sentences.en: I'm not saying, I don't want to say that this is the best place for an animal, obviously.
sentences.zh: 绝对喜欢。

sentences.en: But I'm trying to say that when he was there, he got a lot of attention.
sentences.zh: 我们尽了最大的努力。

sentences.en: I mean, he got all the attention.
sentences.zh: 我们雇佣了最好的人。

sentences.en: We would all the time play and, you know, and he would love that.
sentences.zh: 我们，我们想给凯科最好的，我们捐赠凯科时没有得到任何回报，连一分钱都没有。

sentences.en: Absolutely love that.
sentences.zh: 在凯科计划离开墨西哥的前几天，雷诺冒险乐园的工作人员为它举办了最后一场派对，就像是一场最后的春假狂欢。

sentences.en: We did the best we could.
sentences.zh: 每个人都受邀参加，现任训练员、前员工、凯科所有的朋友，它庞大的人类族群。

sentences.en: We hired the best people.
sentences.zh: 当时我们大概有30个人在那个地方，在海豚厅，我们准备了一顿丰盛的午餐，然后我们都下了水，和凯科一起玩，很多人都哭了，我是说，这很有趣，凯科非常开心，它和每个人都玩得很开心。

sentences.en: We, we wanted the best for Keiko and we donated Keiko without receiving nothing, not, not one cent in return.
sentences.zh: 等等。

sentences.en: A few days before Keiko was scheduled to leave Mexico, the Reno Aventura staff threw him one last party, a kind of final spring break bash.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，雷娜塔，有30个人同时下水和凯科一起玩？

sentences.en: Everyone was invited, current trainers, former staff, all of Keiko's friends, his extended human pod.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So we were like 30 people in this place and in the Delphine room, we made a big lunch and
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: and we all got into the water and we all played with Keiko and there was a lot of crying and I mean, it was, it was fun and Keiko was so happy and he would play with all of them.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你在海洋世界、马林乐园或世界上任何其他水族馆都绝对不可能看到这种情况。

sentences.en: Wait a second.
sentences.zh: 如果你告诉这些大型水族馆的兽医，他们会告诉你，这可不是个好主意，因为动物会感到压力，或者我不知道他们会怎么说，但它当时真的很开心。

sentences.en: So you're telling me, Renata, that like 30 people got in the pool with Keiko at the same time to play?
sentences.zh: 它真的很开心。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 1996年1月6日，凯科该走了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 他们决定在半夜转移它，原因有几个：为了避开高温和交通，也为了避开那些肯定想来告别的人群。

sentences.en: I mean, you would never get this in SeaWorld or Marineland or any other aquarium in the world.
sentences.zh: 搬运任何像虎鲸这么大的物体都是一个工程难题。

sentences.en: If you tell this to a veterinarian from these, you know, huge aquariums, they would tell you
sentences.zh: 但当这个物体是一个活物时，就增加了额外的复杂性。

sentences.en: that, I mean, that's not a good idea because he would, I mean, the animal gets stressed or I mean, I don't know what would they say, but, but he was so happy.
sentences.zh: 把凯科从雷诺冒险乐园运上飞机，很大程度上取决于凯科自己的配合，而这需要训练。

sentences.en: He was so happy.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，他们一直在和它进行训练。

sentences.en: On January 6th, 1996, it was time for Keiko to go.
sentences.zh: 首先，它要游进一个又小又浅的池子，然后进入一个特制的吊索，游进游出，花了几周时间才适应这个过程。

sentences.en: They decided to move him in the middle of the night for a few reasons, to avoid the heat and the traffic, but also the crowds that were sure to want to say their goodbyes.
sentences.zh: 它必须感到舒适，因为一旦进入吊索，它至少要被包裹在里面14个小时。

sentences.en: Moving any object as big as a killer whale is an engineering problem.
sentences.zh: 挑战在于要让它保持冷静。

sentences.en: But when that object is a living thing, there's an added complication.
sentences.zh: 它必须信任人类，不能挣扎或乱动。

sentences.en: Getting Keiko out of Reno Aventura and onto a plane would depend in no small measure on the cooperation of Keiko himself, and that required training.
sentences.zh: 信任。

sentences.en: For months, they'd worked on it with him.
sentences.zh: 转移的那天晚上，现场嘈杂而混乱。

sentences.en: First, he'd swim into a small, shallow pool and then into a custom-made sling, swimming in and out of it, weeks spent just getting comfortable with his process.
sentences.zh: 我看过录像，简直是疯狂。

sentences.en: He had to be comfortable because once he was in that sling, he'd stay wrapped in it for at least 14 hours.
sentences.zh: 看起来不像水族馆，甚至不像游乐园。

sentences.en: The challenge would be to keep him calm.
sentences.zh: 看起来像个建筑工地。

sentences.en: He had to trust his humans, not fight or flail.
sentences.zh: 到处都是移动的设备、马达的轰鸣声、蜂鸣声、喊叫声和灯光。

sentences.en: TruSt.
sentences.zh: 雷娜塔一直待在凯科身边，抚摸着它，靠近它的眼睛，好让它能看到她。

sentences.en: The night of the move, it's noisy and chaotic.
sentences.zh: 但当它该游进浅水池进入吊索时，它拒绝了，无论他们怎么劝说都没用。

sentences.en: I've seen the videos, and it's just manic.
sentences.zh: 最后，十几个人穿着潜水服，用网把它围住，把它拉到了位置上。

sentences.en: It doesn't look like an aquarium or even an amusement park.
sentences.zh: 在浅水池里，雷娜塔和其他训练员把它擦干，然后在它全身涂上润肤霜。

sentences.en: It looks like a construction site.
sentences.zh: 其实，就是那种你可能会给婴儿涂抹以防止尿布疹的东西。

sentences.en: All this movement and whirring of motors and beeps and shouting and lights.
sentences.zh: 你需要保护它的皮肤。

sentences.en: Renata stayed close to Keiko, touching him, close to his eyes so he could see her.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们一直在它身上涂抹厚厚的润肤霜，整个过程中我们一直在和它说话，一直都在说。

sentences.en: But when it was time for him to swim into the shallow pool where the sling awaited him, he refused, and there was nothing they could do to persuade him.
sentences.zh: 但我当时满脑子想的都是它，想它变得有多紧张。

sentences.en: Finally, a dozen people in wetsuits encircled him with a net and pulled him into place.
sentences.zh: 它开始有点哭了，因为它很紧张，每个人也都非常紧张。

sentences.en: In the shallow pool, Renata and the other trainer dried him off before applying moisturizer all over his body.
sentences.zh: 显然，这种情绪会传染给凯科。

sentences.en: Actually, the same stuff you might put on a baby to protect from diaper rash.
sentences.zh: 所以，有些时刻你只能祈祷它能放松下来。

sentences.en: You need his skin to be protected.
sentences.zh: 一旦凯科进入吊索，它就被连接到起重机上，起重机把它从池子里吊出来，放进了一个装有3000磅淡水冰的运输箱里。

sentences.en: So, we were rubbing hard, thick, thick cream all over his body, and we would be talking to him the whole time, the whole time.
sentences.zh: 集装箱放在一辆半挂卡车的后面，准备进行大约一小时的城市穿梭，前往机场。

sentences.en: But I was just thinking about him and how nervous he was getting.
sentences.zh: 到了那里，它会被装上一架巨大的货机。

sentences.en: So, he started crying a little bit because he was nervous, and everybody was so nervous.
sentences.zh: 戴夫说服了UPS免费将凯科运往俄勒冈州。

sentences.en: And you can transfer that to Keiko, obviously.
sentences.zh: 当车队最终离开时，人群比预想的还要多。

sentences.en: So, there are moments where you're just hoping that he just relaxes.
sentences.zh: 那些深爱这头虎鲸的普通人。

sentences.en: Once Keiko was in the sling, it was attached to a crane that lifted him out of the pool and placed him in a shipping container filled with 3,000 pounds of freshwater ice.
sentences.zh: 全家老小。

sentences.en: The container sat on the back of a tractor trailer, ready for the hour or so drive across the city to the airport.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在半夜把父母拉出来，只为了说声再见。

sentences.en: Once there, it would be loaded onto a giant cargo plane.
sentences.zh: 所有人都聚集在雷诺冒险乐园停车场的门外。

sentences.en: David convinced UPS to deliver Keiko to Oregon for free.
sentences.zh: 人数多到警察不得不疏散他们，车队才能通过。

sentences.en: When the caravan finally left, there were crowds, more than they'd expected.
sentences.zh: 他们很快发现，聚集的人群不仅仅是在大门口。

sentences.en: Ordinary people who loved this killer whale.
sentences.zh: 到处都是。

sentences.en: Whole families.
sentences.zh: 我和那天晚上在场的人聊过，他们排在街道两旁，渴望着告别。

sentences.en: Children who dragged their parents out in the middle of the night to say goodbye.
sentences.zh: 有人告诉我，他唯一能想到的类比就是教皇访问墨西哥城的时候。

sentences.en: All gathered just outside the gates of the Reina Aventura parking lot.
sentences.zh: 去机场的路线本应是保密的，但事与愿违。

sentences.en: So many that police had to move them just so the caravan could pass.
sentences.zh: 记者们随时向全城通报车队的进展。

sentences.en: And they soon discovered it wasn't just at the gates that the crowds had gathered.
sentences.zh: 街道两旁站满了成千上万的人。

sentences.en: It was everywhere.
sentences.zh: 穿着睡衣、拿着手写标语的男孩，扎着辫子、挥舞着墨西哥国旗的女孩。

sentences.en: I've talked to a lot of people who were there that night, lining the streets, desperate to say their farewells.
sentences.zh: 青少年们大声呼喊着凯科的名字。

sentences.en: One person told me the only thing he could compare it to was the time the Pope visited
sentences.zh: 你不得不怀疑，那头鲸鱼是否听到了他们的呼喊：

sentences.en: Mexico City.
sentences.zh: “让它留下，让它留下。”

sentences.en: The route to the airport was supposed to be secret, but that's not how it worked out.
sentences.zh: 它应该留下，它应该留下。

sentences.en: Reporters kept the city abreast of the caravan's progress.
sentences.zh: 然后，在前往机场那缓慢而沉重的路途中，某个地方传来了一支墨西哥流浪乐队演奏的一首关于爱人告别的老歌——《燕子》（Las Golondrinas）。

sentences.en: There were thousands of people lining the streets.
sentences.zh: 歌词唱道：疲惫的燕子能去往何方？被风吹散，无处躲藏，记住我的故乡，亲爱的朝圣者，哭泣吧。

sentences.en: Boys in their pajamas carrying handwritten signs and girls in pigtails carrying Mexican flags.
sentences.zh: 汽车和摩托车跟在车队后面，司机们挥手致意，按着喇叭。

sentences.en: Teens shouting and calling Keiko's name.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这有点疯狂，人们脸上的情绪，那种显而易见的失落感。

sentences.en: You have to wonder if the whale could hear them chanting,
sentences.zh: 你不得不怀疑，那头鲸鱼是否听到了他们的呼喊：

sentences.en: Que se quede, que se quede.
sentences.zh: 让他留下，让他留下。

sentences.en: He should stay, he should stay.
sentences.zh: 它应该留下，它应该留下。

sentences.en: Then, somewhere along the slow, ponderous route to the airport, there was a mariachi band playing an old song about a loved one's goodbye, Las Golondrinas.
sentences.zh: 然后，在前往机场那缓慢而沉重的路途中，某个地方传来了一支墨西哥流浪乐队演奏的一首关于爱人告别的老歌——《燕子》（Las Golondrinas）。

sentences.en: Where can the tired swallow go, say the lyrics, tossed by the wind with nowhere to hide, remember my homeland, beloved pilgrim, and cry.
sentences.zh: 歌词唱道：疲惫的燕子能去往何方？被风吹散，无处躲藏，记住我的故乡，亲爱的朝圣者，哭泣吧。

sentences.en: Cars and mopeds follow the procession, drivers waving, honking their horns.
sentences.zh: 汽车和摩托车跟在车队后面，司机们挥手致意，按着喇叭。

sentences.en: Honestly, it's a little bit mad, the emotion on people's faces, the palpable sense of loss.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这有点疯狂，人们脸上的情绪，那种显而易见的失落感。

sentences.en: Dave says some people had to be peeled off Keiko's container as they tried to climb it.
sentences.zh: 戴夫说，有些人试图爬上凯科的集装箱，不得不把他们硬拽下来。

sentences.en: The procession just creeps along as best they can, through the impossibly crowded late-night streets.
sentences.zh: 送行队伍在拥挤不堪的深夜街道上艰难地缓慢前行。

sentences.en: A city, a country, saying goodbye to its beloved whale.
sentences.zh: 一座城市，一个国家，正在向他们挚爱的鲸鱼告别。

sentences.en: We would see all these people on the street with signs, and just want to cry just to remember about it.
sentences.zh: 我们看到街上到处都是举着标语的人，想到那一幕就让人想哭。

sentences.en: And people waving and crying and screaming like, goodbye.
sentences.zh: 人们挥着手，哭喊着，仿佛在说再见。

sentences.en: It was so, so emotional.
sentences.zh: 那场面真是太感人了。

sentences.en: I was sad and happy at the same time, because we're all doing this, because we hope he's going to be, he's going to be okay.
sentences.zh: 我当时既难过又欣慰，因为我们都在做这件事，因为我们希望他能好起来。

sentences.en: But, but it was for, for Mexicans to say goodbye to the only, obviously, orca that they would ever have.
sentences.zh: 但这毕竟是墨西哥人向他们唯一拥有的虎鲸告别的机会。

sentences.en: The UPS plane carrying Keiko to his new home leaves at around five in the morning, more than three hours behind schedule, just before a beautiful Mexican sunrise.
sentences.zh: 载着凯科前往新家的UPS飞机在清晨五点左右起飞，比原定时间晚了三个多小时，刚好赶在美丽的墨西哥日出之前。

sentences.en: Only Keiko's veterinarians fly with him.
sentences.zh: 只有凯科的兽医随行。

sentences.en: Renata and Dave fly alongside in another aircraft, close enough to see Keiko's plane from their window.
sentences.zh: 雷娜塔和戴夫乘坐另一架飞机并排飞行，距离近到从窗户就能看到凯科的飞机。

sentences.en: Keiko no longer belonged to Reno Aventura, much less to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 凯科不再属于雷诺冒险乐园，更不属于墨西哥。

sentences.en: He belonged to the story being told about him, the uncertain, real-life sequel to the movie that had made him a star, only more far-fetched and with no happy ending assured.
sentences.zh: 他属于那个关于他的故事，那是那部让他成名的电影的续集，现实而充满不确定性，而且比电影更离奇，结局也未可知。

sentences.en: It's, it's kind of funny because it was part of, of the movie narrative.
sentences.zh: 这挺有意思的，因为这本身就是电影叙事的一部分。

sentences.en: They were like, how far would you go for a whale?
sentences.zh: 他们当时想的是，为了救一条鲸鱼，你能做到什么地步？

sentences.en: He went as far as, you know, getting him, raising up his arm and saying some magical words and having, and having Willie jump over the breakwater into freedom.
sentences.zh: 他做到了，你知道的，他举起手臂，念出神奇的咒语，让威利跳过防波堤，奔向自由。

sentences.en: I mean, simplistic?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这太简单化了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But that's what our narrative was too.
sentences.zh: 但这正是我们当时叙事的方式。

sentences.en: How far could Keiko go?
sentences.zh: 凯科能走多远？

sentences.en: For the moment, no one knew.
sentences.zh: 目前，没人知道。

sentences.en: That's on the next episode of The Good Whale.
sentences.zh: 敬请收看下一集《好鲸鱼》。

sentences.en: The story we were telling was a beautiful story of things going right.
sentences.zh: 我们讲述的是一个关于一切进展顺利的美好故事。

sentences.en: A simple story, but...
sentences.zh: 一个简单的故事，但是……

sentences.en: He was the absolute worst candidate for a project like that.
sentences.zh: 他绝对是此类项目中最糟糕的候选者。

sentences.en: Come on, Keiko, do it.
sentences.zh: 加油，凯科，做给他们看。

sentences.en: Do it, Keiko.
sentences.zh: 做吧，凯科。

sentences.en: Here he goes, here he goes.
sentences.zh: 他来了，他来了。

sentences.en: There.
sentences.zh: 在那儿。

sentences.en: Ah, little late, little late.
sentences.zh: 啊，晚了一点，晚了一点。

sentences.en: My comment was, that's not a killer whale, that's a golden retriever.
sentences.zh: 我的评价是，那不是虎鲸，那是只金毛寻回犬。
